Remark
[skew endomorphisms acting on volume and curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0375 ↗ conv:pet-ch9-so-metric-convention 1. ch9:9.6.10On an $n$-manifold, verify the following actions of an endomorphism $L$:

  1. If $L$ is skew-symmetric, then $L\omega =0$ for every $n$-form.

  2. In dimension two, every skew-symmetric $L$ satisfies $LR=0$.

  3. Without a skew-symmetry assumption, $L\, \mathrm{vol}=\operatorname {tr}(L)\, \mathrm{vol}$.
